title: Beatrix and the Archive
author: Odile Dunmore
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
